description: Uploads an explicit local HTML or ZIP path into a durable private preparation job. The server never interprets this path. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

file_name.description: Optional safe .html, .htm or .zip source filename; defaults to the local basename.

file_path.description: Explicit path on the MCP client's machine to an HTML or ZIP file.

idempotency_key.description: Stable 8-200 character key; reuse only for the same file.

name: prepare_review
